verdict.rationale: Metorial lets you create publishable and secret API keys, each scoped to an environment. Least-privilege is otherwise enforced at the session level: tool filters allow-list specific tools, and per-user OAuth replaces over-scoped service accounts. Neither is documented as a scope on the credential itself. Missing for 10: per-key permission scopes or fine-grained key restrictions, agent-specific credential issuance, documented mapping of RBAC to API keys, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
